final: WITH per_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) * 1.0 / s.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x_diff, AVG(s.aream2 * 1.0 / s.volm3) AS avg_area_to_volume FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_area_to_volume) AS overall_avg FROM per_source) SELECT ps.fundflux, ps.avg_y_vs_x_diff, ps.avg_area_to_volume, ps.avg_area_to_volume - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg FROM per_source ps CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ps.avg_area_to_volume > o.overall_avg
